Cc: Trust Services Audit Team <audit@trustservices.co>

Subject: SOC 2 + supplemental authn artifacts for October audit window

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

We're kicking off our vendor audit for the month of October and Trust Services asked us to collect the vendor SOC 2 Type II report and a small set of supplemental control artifacts related to authentication & access. Would Redwood be able to provide the following by EOD Oct 12 (our intake deadline)?

- SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Apr 1 2026 - Sep 30 2026
- Bridge letter confirming scope & audit period if the full report is not yet finalized
- MFA enforcement logs (sample slice): successful/failed MFA events tied to user and timestamp (sample window: Sep 20-27)
- SAML assertion trace (redacted) for customer-facing SSO during Sep 2026 (examples only)
- Recent access recertification evidence for privileged roles (Demonstration that reviews occurred in Q3)
- Short note on retention windows for authn/session logs and any known sampling/aggregation we apply

If some items are sensitive, a redacted sample or bridge approach works for Trust Services as long as it includes the audit path and timeframe. Please let us know an ETA and if we should open a secure transfer channel (preferably a pre-authenticated Share link or a DocuSign-style secure artifact upload).

Thanks,
Maya

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can support this.

Quick plan:
- I will confirm SOC 2 Type II delivery/availability and either attach the report or provide a bridge letter by Oct 5.
- Rishi will coordinate the authn log slices and SAML traces; we'll provide a small CSV slice (Sep 20–27) and a redacted SAML example.
- Laura will pull the privileged access recertification artifacts (Q3) and a short retention summary.

Couple quick clarifying asks so we scope the extracts correctly:
1) For the MFA slice — do you want only successful events, or both success + failures? (We can deliver both but failures include more PII.)
2) For SAML traces — we will redact PII but preserve Subject, Issuer, AssertionID, and timestamps. Is that acceptable?
3) Preferred delivery: secure Drive link (I can create a pre-auth link and set a 30-day expiration) or encrypted ZIP via our SOC upload portal?

We aim to have the packet ready by end of day Mon Oct 5 and will update you if anything takes longer.

-Stephanie

Steph / Laura — taking the lead on logs. Quick notes on feasibility and extract plan: 

- MFA events: we can provide both successes and failures for the Sep 20–27 window. The schema will include event_ts, user_id (hashed), event_type (mfa.success / mfa.failure), auth_method, source_ip (last octet redacted).
- SAML assertion traces: we can export assertion metadata for requests hitting prod clusters in us-west and redact attributes that contain PHI/PII. We'll include AssertionID, Issuer, Subject (hashed), NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter, and audience.
- Access recertification: Q3 review artifacts live in the governance workbook; I will extract the signed-off CSV and a PDF snapshot of the review ticket.
- Retention summary: our authn/session logs are retained raw for 90 days, aggregated summaries for 13 months. We will include the retention matrix in the packet.

Time plan: I can deliver the CSV sample and SAML redaction example by Mon Oct 5 COB. Bridge letter and SOC 2 PDF depend on Legal & Compliance sign-off — ETA Mon Oct 5 noon.

Attachments: (I will attach the sample files in the next message)

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Manager, Reliability & Security | Redwood Inference

Subject: Delivery: SOC 2 Type II (Apr–Sep 2026), bridge letter, and authn sample extracts for Valence

Maya / Trust Services team — attaching the artifacts we discussed. See notes below.

Attachments included:
- redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report covering 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30) [Attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-2026.pdf (application/pdf, 2.3MB)]
- bridge-letter-redwood-20261005.pdf (Bridge letter confirming control coverage and audit window for customers awaiting final report) [Attachment: bridge-letter-redwood-20261005.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)]
- authn-log-sample-valence-20261004.csv (Sample of MFA events 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-27; fields hashed/redacted where required) [Attachment: authn-log-sample-valence-20261004.csv (text/csv, 72KB)]

Summary / notes on the artifacts:
- The SOC 2 PDF is the finalized Type II for the period you requested. If you need a signed bridge instead, the attached bridge letter is intended to be used when sharing is delayed for any reason.
- The CSV contains both mfa.success and mfa.failure rows; user identifiers are salted hashes and IP addresses have the last octet masked to protect user privacy. Audit column 'auth_path' shows whether the event came via mobile OTP / TOTP / WebAuthn.
- SAML traces: for privacy we included a redacted example inside the Drive folder rather than embedding in the packet. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Valence-Audit-2026 (pre-auth link, expires 2026-11-05). The redaction preserves AssertionID, Issuer, timestamps and audience.
- Access recertification evidence: Laura has uploaded the signed CSV snapshot and the Q3 review ticket PDF to the same Drive folder.
- Retention: authn logs raw retention = 90 days; aggregated retention = 13 months. We included the retention matrix as retention-matrix.txt in the Drive folder.

If you need the raw SAML XML for a specific assertion ID for validation, we can provide it under a tighter NDAs/access channel — let me know the AssertionID and we'll flag Legal to approve the transfer.

Next steps / ask: please confirm receipt and whether the redactions meet your auditor's requirements. If Trust Services needs anything else (e.g., a signed attestation that the CSV sample is representative of prod), let us know and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
-Stephanie
